resolutions: Nominal incorporation is one canonical operation combining typed NNC and VNC Sources rather than a list of example-specific routes.
The noun contributes its general-use stem and the application preserves the internal NNC-VNC boundary.
Object, adverb, and complement are distinct grammatical relations rather than translation labels.
Only incorporated-object formation reduces matrix valence under the accepted Groups 1-3 scope.
An incorporated object fills exactly one typed matrix object position.
A single-object matrix therefore becomes intransitive and carries no nuclear object pronoun.
The finite subject is preserved when the sole object position is consumed.
A double-object matrix retains one object after incorporation.
A triple-object matrix retains two objects after incorporation.
Remaining objects keep their governor and derivational level instead of being rebuilt from surface spelling.
The structurally oldest compatible object is consumed automatically when the typed Source supplies one match.
A role control is required only when the typed Source explicitly supplies more than one compatible object match.
A requested role that is not among the typed compatible matches is rejected.
An intransitive matrix cannot authorize incorporated-object formation.
The passive of a single-object incorporated Result is rejected because no object remains to support it.
Compatible invented nounstem and verbstem shapes pass the same productive rule; Canvas witnesses never gate admission.
The complete canonical VNC Result remains available through the ordinary Later derivation projection.
All 148 accepted atoms have exact normal, mutation, clickable-cue, and collapsed reading-guide routes.
